{{Otheruses|Beta Company}}
'''Beta Company''' was one of several training [[Company/Legends|companies]] of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They were trained by [[Kal Skirata]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
